description: Get analyticsV2 source or product analytics for a community. Business and community refer to the same thing and are interchangeable. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. FREE businesses cannot use this tool, regardless of individual feature rows. Call check_business_tool_access before collecting inputs. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

endDate.description: End of the reporting window (ISO 8601 date).

filter.description: Dimension to break the analytics down by.

productId.description: Product ID, from a Nas.com product listing for this business.

startDate.description: Start of the reporting window (ISO 8601 date).

name: get_community_analytics_v2
title: Get Business Analytics V2
